title: Annihilation of Euler–Lie derivatives makes τ(M,θ,ξ) invariant under the dilation pull-backs (homotopy constancy)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and R = (M, θ, ξ) ∈ IMRep(ℝ^P, n). Assume that R.action(γ) = 0 for all test forms β, γ ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P) (TestFormOn univ n) satisfying γ(y) = n·β(y) + Dβ(y)[y] for every y (γ is the Lie derivative of β along the Euler field X(y) = y; Dβ(y) = fderiv ℝ β y). Then for every λ > 0 and all ω, ω' ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P) with ω'(y) = λ^{−n}·ω(λ^{−1}y) for every y, R.action(ω') = R.action(ω).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), (∀ β γ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, (∀ y, (γ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) y = (n : ℝ) • (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) y + fderiv ℝ (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) y y) → R.action (γ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) = 0) → ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ ω ω' : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, (∀ y, (ω' : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) y = (lam⁻¹ ^ n) • (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (lam⁻¹ • y)) → R.action (ω' : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) = R.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)
